pages.title: Page Curve Analyzer
pages.text: Follows the entropy of a black hole's radiation as it evaporates - and finds the information coming back out.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Follows Hawking quanta through an evaporation: firewall shards and soft hair, the Page curve, islands, and the Bekenstein bound.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 2 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Bekenstein Crystal, Firewall Shard, Island Fragment, Page Curve Record, Soft Hair Filament.
